import urllib.request, json, time, datetime
sym = "AVAXUSDT"
now = time.time()*1000
T = lambda ms: datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ms/1000 + 3*3600, datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%H:%M")
px = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/ticker/price?symbol=" + sym))["price"]
print("сейчас", T(now), "цена", px)
n = 3
for tf in ("5m", "15m", "1h"):
    kl = [k for k in json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=%s&interval=%s&limit=150" % (sym, tf))) if k[6] < now]
    hs = [float(k[2]) for k in kl]; ls = [float(k[3]) for k in kl]
    ph = [(T(kl[i][0]), hs[i]) for i in range(n, len(kl)-n) if hs[i] > max(hs[i-n:i]) and hs[i] >= max(hs[i+1:i+1+n])]
    pl = [(T(kl[i][0]), ls[i]) for i in range(n, len(kl)-n) if ls[i] < min(ls[i-n:i]) and ls[i] <= min(ls[i+1:i+1+n])]
    print("\n%s: последняя закрытая свеча %s, max за последние 12 свечей %.3f (в %s)" % (tf, T(kl[-1][0]), max(hs[-12:]), T(kl[hs.index(max(hs[-12:]), len(hs)-12)][0])))
    print("  pivot-макс (время старта свечи, цена):", [(t, round(p,3)) for t, p in ph[-6:]])
    print("  pivot-мин:", [(t, round(p,3)) for t, p in pl[-6:]])
# где 15m-максимум 10.547 и что с ним на 1h
kl15 = [k for k in json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=%s&interval=15m&limit=150" % sym)) if k[6] < now]
top = max(kl15[-40:], key=lambda k: float(k[2]))
print("\nсамая высокая 15m свеча за последние 10 ч: старт %s, high %s" % (T(top[0]), top[2]))
kl1h = [k for k in json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=%s&interval=1h&limit=150" % sym)) if k[6] < now]
print("1h свечи (последние 8): ", [(T(k[0]), k[2]) for k in kl1h[-8:]])
